description: Lives Lost on NT Roads is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Road Safety Data. Annual crash statistics for fatalities and serious injuries in the NT. Provides information on road user groups, key contributing factors, demographics, crash type, road surface and location of the fatality or serious injury. The information is provided to the Department of Infrastructure, Planning and Logistics following an initial report from the NT Police. Coverage: NT. The portal files it under the publisher Road Safety Data. Its tags are Crash, Fatality, Injury, Intrastate, LGA - Local Government Area. It offers 1 resource(s) in HTML. The portal shows 2026-05-15 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
